product.name: AI-powered Automation for Insurance
product.description: Automates manual and repetitive insurance brokerage tasks using AI workers to handle data and operations processes.

product.name: Contract & Policy Review
product.description: Reviews insurance requirements and policies to ensure compliance and accuracy.

product.name: Apps & Submissions
product.description: Pre-fills insurance applications, creates submissions, and monitors for issues during the process.

product.name: Audit
product.description: Ensures accuracy of applications and carrier portal data through automated audits.

product.name: Quoting
product.description: Gathers insurance quotes and indications automatically to support brokerage operations.

product.name: Certificates of Insurance
product.description: Automates coverage analysis and issuance of Certificates of Insurance (COIs).
